CFML Language Reference: Functions

BitSHRN

Shifts a 32-bit integer count bits to the right. Bits shifted past bit 0 are lost and zeros come in from the left (an unsigned, or logical, shift).

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

BitSHRN(number, count)

Parameters

number
A 32-bit integer.
count
Number of positions to shift, 0 to 31.

Returns

A non-negative integer.

Usage

For positive numbers, shifting right by n is the same as Int(number / 2^n). Because zeros come in from the left, a negative number becomes a large positive one: BitSHRN(-1, 28) is 15.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).

<CFLOOP INDEX="args" LIST="256:4,255:4,65535:8,1999:1,-1:28">
<CFSET n = ListFirst(args, ":")><CFSET c = ListLast(args, ":")>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#c#</TD>
<TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#BitSHRN(n, c)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
